decisions.reason: Devore decoration fabric is very close to the firm's existing textile design and finishing knowledge, so its absorptive capacity to refine variants is high despite limited public evidence after launch.

A transparent burnout decorative fabric builds directly on established burnout and decorative-fabric capabilities, making it a product the firm can likely learn from and improve within its current knowledge base.
Standard burnout decorative fabric appears to be among the most related products to the firm's prior know-how, so management would be inclined to retain it unless sales were clearly weak.

A velour-like upholstery fabric is adjacent but somewhat less central to a decorative-textiles knowledge base, so a medium-sized firm would be more likely to reallocate resources if early results were uncertain.

A flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric adds technical requirements but still fits textile manufacturing capabilities and offers a more defensible niche if the firm can absorb and apply the needed compliance knowledge.

A polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is relatively standard and easier for competitors to supply, so if early market feedback was inconclusive the firm would likely withdraw it and focus on more knowledge-intensive lines.
